ThinkingBudget.note: Ported from the product's own slider row: Label left, mono value readout right, full-width bg-input track with the accent-foreground thumb at 64%.

Stepped.note: Integer step scale with min/max tick labels; thumb lands on a discrete stop.

Extremes.note: Two rows put the thumb at min and at max, showing both ends of the track geometry in one cell.

Disabled.note: Disabled track and thumb render at reduced opacity with the not-allowed cursor class applied — visibly distinct from the enabled cells.
